service_rifle.name: Service Rifle
service_rifle.desc: The old navy's standard long gun, easy to find now that so few are left to carry one: 5 to 9 damage, using Perception and Firearms.

slug_thrower.name: Powder Pistol
slug_thrower.desc: An antique pistol that fires real metal, loud and cheap to feed: 2 to 6 damage, using Agility and Firearms.

shock_baton.name: Shock Baton
shock_baton.desc: A dockside baton with a charge in the grip and a smell of burned air: 3 to 6 damage, using Might and Melee.

boarding_axe.name: Boarding Axe
boarding_axe.desc: Forged to cut hatch seals, and it doesn't mind what's behind them: 4 to 9 damage, using Might and Melee.

forge_hammer.name: Forge Hammer
forge_hammer.desc: A Korrun smith's hammer, balanced for arms built on a heavy world: 6 to 10 damage, using Might and Melee.

veshti_longrifle.name: Veshti Longrifle
veshti_longrifle.desc: A rifle nearly as long as its Veshti owner, made for shots across open vacuum: 7 to 12 damage, using Perception and Firearms.

ministry_saber.name: Ministry Saber
ministry_saber.desc: The thin dueling blade of Vantor's secret police, and people will ask how you got it: 7 to 13 damage, using Agility and Melee.

work_suit.name: Work Suit
work_suit.desc: Patched dock coveralls with padding at the joints: +1 defense.

refugee_coat.name: Refugee Coat
refugee_coat.desc: Warm and patched from three other coats, it stops nothing, but nobody in a crowd looks at it twice: +1 on checks in crowds while carried.

korrun_harness.name: Korrun Harness
korrun_harness.desc: Load-bearing plate from the Korrath forges, built to hold a body up under crushing weight: +3 defense, and +2 on checks in heavy gravity while carried.

veshti_skin.name: Veshti Skin
veshti_skin.desc: The thin pressure layer the Long Families wear under everything: +2 defense, and +2 on checks in vacuum while carried.

remnant_plate.name: Remnant Plate
remnant_plate.desc: Concord assault armor kept like new by people who won't admit the war is over, and people still salute it: +4 defense, and +1 on Leadership checks while carried.

trauma_kit.name: Trauma Kit
trauma_kit.desc: Restores 30 health, plus your Medicine rank.

ration_pack.name: Ration Pack
ration_pack.desc: Restores 4 health, plus your Medicine rank.

calm_tabs.name: Calm Tabs
calm_tabs.desc: Restores 2 energy, but does nothing for stress.

nutrient_gel.name: Nutrient Gel
nutrient_gel.desc: Restores 6 health, plus your Medicine rank, and 1 energy.

emergency_patch.name: Emergency Hull Patch
emergency_patch.desc: Restores 8 ship hull, plus twice your Engineering rank.

signal_scrambler.name: Signal Scrambler
signal_scrambler.desc: A pocket jammer that smears your trace on anyone's sensors: +2 on Stealth checks while carried.

slicer_rig.name: Intrusion Rig
slicer_rig.desc: A Kessara-built cracking deck, illegal everywhere that still has laws: +3 on Hacking checks while carried, and one spoof to shake off a trace in the Intrusion Console.

surgeon_lens.name: Surgeon's Lens
surgeon_lens.desc: A jeweler's eyepiece rebuilt for field surgery: +2 on Medicine checks while carried.

field_scanner.name: Field Scanner
field_scanner.desc: A battered handheld scanner, still in calibration: +2 on Awareness checks and +1 on Science checks while carried.

tool_roll.name: Tool Roll
tool_roll.desc: A canvas roll of well-kept tools that someone once trusted with their life: +2 on Engineering checks while carried.

nav_slate.name: Nav Slate
nav_slate.desc: A scratched slate of jump tables, with corrections in four different hands: +2 on Navigation checks while carried.

resonance_tuner.name: Resonance Tuner
resonance_tuner.desc: A forked crystal from the old monasteries that you hold against your teeth to hear the field: +2 on Attunement checks while carried.

ledger_of_favors.name: Ledger of Favors
ledger_of_favors.desc: A worn book of who owes whom from here to Kessara: +2 on Commerce checks and +1 on Streetwise checks while carried, and the Commerce bonus also improves market prices.

old_concord_medal.name: Old Concord Medal
old_concord_medal.desc: A service medal from the old navy, and people still straighten up when they see it: +2 on Leadership checks while carried.

pilot_gloves.name: Pilot's Gloves
pilot_gloves.desc: Worn flight gloves with the fingertips rewired for feel: +2 on Piloting checks while carried.

quiet_token.name: Quiet Token
quiet_token.desc: A smooth silver disc that the Quiet press into the hands of the frightened, and people who carry one sleep very well.

remnant_codes.name: Remnant Codes
remnant_codes.desc: Recognition codes for the Concord Remnant's warships, good until someone notices they've gone missing.

gate_key.name: Gate Key
gate_key.desc: A fist-sized ring of pale, seamless metal that grows heavier the closer it gets to the Pale Gate.

ninth_vault_index.name: Ninth Vault Index
ninth_vault_index.desc: A brittle handwritten list of what's sealed in the Ninth Vault of Sarn, and the First Keeper would very much like it back.

asterion_voice_recording.name: Asterion Recording
asterion_voice_recording.desc: Eleven minutes of voices pulled off the dead wires of Asterion, and every time you play it, it runs a little longer.

unbound_safe_conduct.name: Unbound Safe-Conduct
unbound_safe_conduct.desc: A signed data tag from the Unbound that their sentries will honor once, and only for the person it was given to.

wheel_marker.name: Wheel Marker
wheel_marker.desc: A gilded chip that records a debt at the Gilded Wheel, and the House always remembers who holds it.

lumen_lens.name: Lumen Lens
lumen_lens.desc: A disc of Ilari glass from Lumen Sanctuary that shows the feelings of whoever you look at through it, as if they had Ilari skin.

maris_core_sample.name: Maris Core Sample
maris_core_sample.desc: A sealed tube of material drilled out of the drowned structure at Maris Deep, and it won't cool down.

tessen_seed_vault_key.name: Tessen Seed Vault Key
tessen_seed_vault_key.desc: The old iron key to Tessen Colony's seed vault, which holds enough to plant a world and the whole of the colony's future.
